editorial_thesis: Today’s useful edge is not another model wrapper: it is faster feedback, explicit agent identity, and reusable design workflows that can cross tool boundaries.

topic_groups.title: Real-time Agent Feedback Loops
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh Aug 13 signal on frontier-model latency creates a materially new lane after recent coverage focused on control planes and persistence.

sources.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
sources.why_selected: OpenAI is previewing a Cerebras-backed tier with up to 750 output tokens per second.
sources.usefulness: Test whether lower latency changes interactive incident response, voice, or research workflows.

sources.title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
sources.why_selected: Native sandbox execution and portable workspace manifests make the speed signal operationally actionable.
sources.usefulness: Use sandboxed, file-grounded experiments instead of building bespoke harnesses.

sources.title: Build long-running AI agents that pause, resume, and never lose context with ADK
sources.why_selected: It supplies the durable-state pattern needed when faster models increase action frequency.
sources.usefulness: Model approvals and resumptions as explicit checkpoints, not chat-history inference.

topic_groups.title: Agent Identity + Governance
topic_groups.selection_rationale: The CSA’s Aug 13 threat ranking elevates identity and AI compromise together, filling a security/governance gap in the last several days.

sources.title: CSA 2026 Top Cloud Threats Report
sources.why_selected: IAM ranks first; AI-enhanced attacks and AI system compromise enter the top threats.
sources.usefulness: Turn non-human identity, privilege, and AI asset ownership into first-class review fields.

sources.title: Agent Access Model
sources.why_selected: Cloudflare’s emerging architecture frames task-scoped agents around identity brokering and continuous mediation.
sources.usefulness: Use as a design reference for task-scoped credentials and revocable access.

sources.title: Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available
sources.why_selected: Certificate alerts now require more operator scrutiny because issued certificates are no longer emailed by default.
sources.usefulness: Add CT monitoring to client domain hygiene and incident triage playbooks.

topic_groups.title: Design Workflows Become Agent-Portable
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Figma’s Aug 13 skills release is a fresh, practical product/design signal and a meaningful extension of the previously covered Figma controls.

sources.title: Try skills from the Community and make your own with the Figma agent
sources.why_selected: Figma now offers 50+ community skills, custom skill authoring, and publishing through Community.
sources.usefulness: Package Buildn’s repeatable design-review and handoff conventions as portable Markdown skills.

sources.title: Figma MCP: Run Weave tools from your favorite agent
sources.why_selected: External clients can invoke Figma Weave tools through MCP while preserving context and brand guidance.
sources.usefulness: Prototype agent-to-design actions without forcing a context switch.

sources.title: The new business case for design systems
sources.why_selected: Design-system governance provides the durable substrate for reusable skills and AI-assisted production.
sources.usefulness: Make tokens, components, and review rules inspectable inputs to client delivery.
